aeTXg55J_qg.title: Uttam Shaucha Dharma, उत्तम शौच धर्म, 15 Sep 2002
aeTXg55J_qg.why: Taken down from the channel on purpose — Tejas confirmed it on 27 September 2026. This is Uttam Shaucha Dharma, the fifth of the ten days of the Daslakshan festival of 2002, so the series has a gap on the site until it is published again: the other nine days all play. It was last seen on the channel as a scheduled premiere, with no duration.
